title: narcissus pseuditalicus
intro: Narcissus pseuditalicus, commonly known as Italian daffodil or Pheasant's eye, is a species of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cognitive function, and its therapeutic actions, which include sedation and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Narcissus pseuditalicus include alkaloids such as galanthamine and lycorine, which have been shown to possess neuroprotective and anticholinesterase activities. The plant's bioactive compounds may also exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, contributing to its potential use in traditional medicine.
